fusions.name: Rolled Under
fusions.desc: Clamps the target and rolls for 18 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: The One Bite
fusions.desc: Hooks the target for 30 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Still Until Ripe
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wait, increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed After Basking
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, you heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
